description: Header file defining classes and functions for Windows Registry manipulation, including RegKey, RegistryValueIterator, and RegistryKeyIterator.

classes.name: RegKey
classes.description: Utility class for reading, writing, and manipulating Windows Registry keys.

classes.name: RegistryValueIterator
classes.description: Iterator for registry values within a specific registry folder.

classes.name: RegistryKeyIterator
classes.description: Iterator for subkeys within a registry folder.

methods.name: ReadValueDW
methods.description: Reads a DWORD value from the registry.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a string value from the registry.

methods.name: WriteValue
methods.description: Writes a value to the registry.
